subject.title: ci(swift): enforce shared OpenClawKit dead-code coverage

question: May this PR treat every OpenClawKit declaration unused by the current iOS and macOS consumers as removable, including public source-compatibility overloads and types?
rationale: Periphery proves liveness for the two scanned applications, but it cannot determine whether public declarations are an intentional supported source contract for tests, downstream packages, or separately built companion-app code.

options.title: Confirm internal-only API
options.body: Confirm OpenClawKit public visibility is only cross-target implementation detail, then merge after the exact-head shared scans complete successfully.

options.title: Preserve compatibility surface
options.body: Retain or explicitly ignore public compatibility declarations until supported consumers and a deprecation or breaking-change policy are documented.

recommendation.title: Confirm internal-only API
recommendation.body: Confirm OpenClawKit public visibility is only cross-target implementation detail, then merge after the exact-head shared scans complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this person with both iOS and macOS ownership, spanning the two consumers and the shared package boundary.
